title: Tanker Shipping - November 3, 2026
summary: VLCC Remain Strong on Low Vessel Availability, Geopolitics - The recovery in Short-term Indicators Middle Eastern crude exports has yet to restore normal tanker circulation, with Momentum: Negative October flows through Hormuz averaging approximately 11.7 million barrels/day, up from 9.8 million barrels/day in September but below the pre-war level of 14.5 million Sentiment: Positive barrels/day. Meanwhile, Middle Eastern VLCC tonne-miles remain 34% below Fundamentals: Positive 2025 levels and tonne-days 24% below pre-war levels, highlighting the disconnect between exceptionally high freight and underlying transportation demand. Around Breakwave Tanker 80 VLCCs remain engaged in Gulf-of-Oman shuttle operations, with average 18392 Futures Index: round voyages extending to 23 days against an optimal 9-10 days, while offshore 30D: -0.3% ↓ transfer bottlenecks and dedicated producer-controlled employment continue to constrain spot availability.
